mcq_merge.notes: Original tmp location required. Archived reproduction/ copy derives the wrong repository root. Depends on historical parser install_extended_answer_parser and absolute recovered-publication inputs; requires staging/refactoring before portable use. Saved-response parsing only, not inference.

mcq_regenerate.notes: Original tmp location required. Copies recipes, stages samples and runs 15 offline analyses. Will overwrite historical derived outputs in-place if run against original artifacts; use isolated staged tree. Not executed in this handoff.

monitor_regenerate.notes: Supplies corrected() and executes patched recipes. luna-overview/recipe.py alone is not standalone. Hardcoded saved monitor-score roots and other jobs need staging. No monitor inference.

switch.notes: Requires corrected-stage samples.json, sibling helper recipes and chart template; writes to stage directories. Model/grader calls absent. Full aggregation not tested in this handoff.

conditional.notes: Requires corrected-stage samples.json, sibling helper recipes and chart template; writes to stage directories. Model/grader calls absent. Full aggregation not tested in this handoff.

verbalisation.notes: Requires corrected-stage samples.json, sibling helper recipes and chart template; writes to stage directories. Model/grader calls absent. Full aggregation not tested in this handoff.

accuracy.notes: Requires corrected-stage samples.json, sibling helper recipes and chart template; writes to stage directories. Model/grader calls absent. Full aggregation not tested in this handoff.

convergence.notes: Requires methods-meeting-20260911/training-histories.json and local remote-histories.json; outputs in historical artifact directory. Saved history aggregation, no SSH.

aita.notes: Requires plan-v3.json, results/, results64/retry-plan.json and 12 complete receipt JSONs. Audits receipt IDs/hashes and aggregates scores; no target calls. Writes plots64 in place.

image.notes: Requires collected/rows.json and recovered-rows.json, recovery.py, shared renderer/statistical helpers. Historical exact input template not pinned in old provenance; current CLI is explicit. Traceable recipe, not claimed byte-identical reproduction of old PDFs.

compute.notes: Saved remote.json, initial-trace.json, rmct-initial.json and rmct-continuation-sacct.txt; writes summary.json. Manuscript table transcription is manual, not generated by this command.

organism.notes: Requires preserved scored logs and historical companion figures/templates; native Inspect mean/stderr, no rescoring. Output must not exist. Manuscript table transcription manual.
